description: Bind objects to a product card's similar-products settings or unbind them (up to 500 per call). product_card_ids work only in SELECTED_CARDS mode, category_ids and collection_ids only in SELECTED_CATEGORIES_COLLECTIONS — send either cards or categories/collections, never both. One-directional: only this card's settings change, the listed cards get no reverse link (unlike the deprecated symmetric AddSimilarProductCards/DeleteSimilarProductCards).

action.description: Whether to bind or unbind the objects.

objects.description: Objects to bind or unbind; at least one non-empty list.

product_card_ids.description: Product card IDs (UUID) — SELECTED_CARDS mode only.

product_card_id.description: Product card ID (UUID) — the variant's product_card_id, not a product or variant ID.

name: manage_similar_cards_objects
title: Add or remove similar-products objects
